# Reproducible outputs

This fixture uses only each language's standard library or base installation. Every cell declares ordinary project artifacts and runs through the selected shared Jupyter kernel on Windows, macOS, or Linux.

```{python} #phase3-python-figure .execute produces="figures/generated/python-profile.svg"
from pathlib import Path

points = [(0, 82), (32, 67), (64, 51), (96, 40), (128, 34), (160, 31)]
polyline = " ".join(f"{24 + x},{18 + y}" for x, y in points)
svg = f'''<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="240" height="140" viewBox="0 0 240 140">
  <rect width="240" height="140" rx="12" fill="#fafaf8"/>
  <path d="M24 112H216M24 18V112" stroke="#cbc9c2" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polyline points="{polyline}" fill="none" stroke="#355e52" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="24" y="132" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#5e625e">Python canopy profile</text>
</svg>'''
path = Path("figures/generated/python-profile.svg")
path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path.write_text(svg, encoding="utf-8")
```

```{r} #phase3-r-table .execute produces="tables/generated/r-summary.csv"
weeks <- 1:4
area <- c(12.0, 18.5, 26.0, 33.5)
summary <- data.frame(week = weeks, leaf_area = area)
dir.create("tables/generated", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
write.csv(summary, "tables/generated/r-summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{julia} #phase3-julia-bundle .execute produces="figures/generated/julia-trajectory.svg,tables/generated/julia-trajectory.csv"
using DelimitedFiles

days = collect(0:4)
biomass = [1.0, 1.8, 3.1, 4.9, 7.2]
mkpath("tables/generated")
writedlm("tables/generated/julia-trajectory.csv", hcat(days, biomass), ',')

points = join(["$(28 + day * 38),$(112 - round(Int, value * 11))" for (day, value) in zip(days, biomass)], " ")
svg = """<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="240" height="140" viewBox="0 0 240 140">
  <rect width="240" height="140" rx="12" fill="#fafaf8"/>
  <path d="M24 112H216M24 18V112" stroke="#cbc9c2" stroke-width="1"/>
  <polyline points="$points" fill="none" stroke="#725d38" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="24" y="132" font-family="sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#5e625e">Julia biomass trajectory</text>
</svg>"""
mkpath("figures/generated")
write("figures/generated/julia-trajectory.svg", svg)
```

The prose after the executable cells must remain byte-identical during repeated output materialization.
